# Claude Code automation recommender (Anthropic)

Analyzes your codebase and recommends hooks, subagents, skills and MCP servers to set up.

- Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official/main/plugins/claude-code-setup/skills/claude-automation-recommender/SKILL.md
- Author: Anthropic
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/claude-code-automation-recommender-anthropic-0d441fec

Inspects a project (languages, tools, dependencies, existing Claude config) and recommends which Claude Code features would help most, such as specific hooks, subagents, skills, plugins or MCP servers, with reasons and setup tips. It's read-only analysis and is useful when first setting up Claude Code on a repo.

**Try asking:**
- "What Claude Code automations should I set up for this repo?"
- "How should I configure Claude Code for this project?"
- "Recommend hooks and MCP servers for our stack"
